newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 42-week T-bill ave yield rises to 12.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 42-week T-bill ave yield rises to 12.62 pct.

text.p: Average yield at the Slovak Finance Ministry's auction of 42-week treasury bills hit 12.62 percent, up from 11.94 percent in the last auction of T-bills with a similar maturity, the central bank said on Wednesday.
This was the first auction of the 42-week T-bills this year, but the ministry has held several auctions of treasury bills with maturities of 40 and 41 weeks.
In the last successful auction of ministry T-bills with a maturity of 41 weeks on December 4, the average yield hit 11.94 percent, up from 11.25 percent.
The ministry does not announce the amount of bills on offer at its auctions.
